report.summary: 4 findings survive: incomplete-derivation (critical), exception-silence-risk (medium), import-error-handling-gap (medium), unmeasured-vectors-contract (low). Deliverables: fix derive_task_from_commit, audit render_brief callers, test _catches_import_error gap, locate UNMEASURED tests.
risks: derive_task_from_commit returns None, breaking any caller expecting a dict
render_brief eats all exceptions silently; callers may not guard against empty string
_catches_import_error misses bare except/except Exception, inflating reachability
UNMEASURED constant may drift without detection if no test enforces it
todos: Fix derive_task_from_commit to populate f2p/p2p lists and return the dict
Add test confirming derive_task_from_commit returns non-None dict
Audit all callers of render_brief for empty-string handling
Add unit test for _catches_import_error with bare except and except Exception blocks
Search for tests referencing UNMEASURED; if none, add a test that checks its contents
Merge the fix for incomplete-derivation into the next gate-1 slice

items.title: Fix derive_task_from_commit to populate f2p/p2p and return the dict
items.why_now: Confirmed critical: function returns None, breaking any caller that expects a dict. No other item depends on this fix, but it blocks correctness evaluation.

steps.do: Edit derive_task_from_commit in daedalus/eval/correctness.py to append to f2p and p2p lists and return {'overlay': overlay, 'f2p': f2p, 'p2p': p2p}
steps.verified_by: python -c "from daedalus.eval.correctness import derive_task_from_commit; result = derive_task_from_commit('.', 'HEAD'); assert isinstance(result, dict) and 'overlay' in result and 'f2p' in result and 'p2p' in result"

steps.do: Add a test in tests/test_eval_correctness.py that calls derive_task_from_commit with a real git commit and asserts the returned dict has non-None f2p and p2p lists

items.assumption: The function's intended behavior is to return a dict with overlay, f2p, p2p keys. The exact population logic for f2p/p2p needs to be inferred from context (e.g., file renames).

items.title: Audit all callers of render_brief for empty-string handling
items.why_now: render_brief can return '' on any exception; callers may not guard against empty string, causing silent data loss. Fixing this prevents hard-to-debug failures.

steps.do: Search codebase for all calls to render_brief (including imports and references). List each call site and inspect whether the caller checks for empty string before using the result.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'render_brief' daedalus/ | wc -l; manual inspection of each call site

steps.do: If any caller does not guard against '', either add a guard or modify render_brief to return a sentinel (e.g., None) on error so callers must handle it.
steps.verified_by: python -c "from daedalus.lanes.graph_brief import render_brief; assert render_brief(None, '') is not None or render_brief(None, '') == ''"

items.assumption: The current behavior of returning '' on exception is intentional; we assume at least one caller may not handle ''.

items.title: Add unit test for _catches_import_error with bare except and except Exception
items.why_now: Confirmed gap: imports inside bare except or except Exception are not recognized as suppressed, inflating reachability. A test will confirm the gap and prevent regression.

steps.do: Add a test in tests/test_reach.py that creates a try block with bare except or except Exception containing an import, passes it to _split_imports, and asserts the import is not marked as suppressed.

items.assumption: The test file tests/test_reach.py exists and contains tests for _split_imports. If not, the test may need to be placed elsewhere.

items.title: Locate and enforce UNMEASURED constant via test
items.why_now: If no test references UNMEASURED, its documentation may drift silently. Adding a test ensures the constant's contents are verified.

steps.do: Search for all references to UNMEASURED in the codebase. If no test exists, add a test that imports the constant and checks its value (e.g., assert UNMEASURED == expected value).
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'UNMEASURED' daedalus/ tests/; if zero test matches, add test in appropriate test file

items.assumption: The constant UNMEASURED is defined somewhere in the codebase; its location is unknown from the provided index.
